title: Cinder Mile
blurb: One hour on the wire, and three people who cannot all leave with what they want.
pitch: Nim wants the posts to stay a true map of the tower, because she walks out at dawn and a wrong mile kills her. Pell wants tonight's hour to go out on the wire, because a listener stops waiting at sunrise. Maro wants the painted numbers to stay a mile false, because a true number leads the scrap gang to the houses. Every choice is a real roll — failure opens a new road, never a retry.

chapters.title: The Painted Yard
chapters.setting: The relay will speak for one hour tonight, and only if the crank teeth catch. It repeats whatever number is on the post. Nim wants the posts to stay a true map of the tower, because she walks out at dawn and a wrong mile kills her. Pell wants tonight's hour to go out on the wire, because a listener on the far side of the salt stops waiting at sunrise. Maro stands on the ladder with a number a mile false, because a true number leads the scrap gang to the houses. At dawn the gang pulls every post that still has a readable number. The paint is wet. The wire can carry one thing. Silence carries nothing.
chapters.objective: Choose which price you will pay while the paint is still wet.

choices.label: Give Pell your road-oil so the crank can seat

success.text: The oil seats the teeth. The lamp is out, and Nim memorized nothing. The hour can catch, and she will walk in the dark.

failure.text: The tin bursts. Oil and gravel spoil the wet post. The housing stays dry and will not turn.

complication.text: The burst fires the housing and chars the row. The wire burns, and the posts go blank.

bonus.text: The oil seats the teeth on the first pour, and her hands stay clean. The lamp is out, and Nim memorized nothing. The hour can catch, and she will walk in the dark.

choices.label: Burn the spare solder into the teeth

success.text: The spare solder is gone. The teeth will hold for one night and never again.

failure.text: The bead runs cold and the teeth never meet. The housing will not turn.

complication.text: The bead bridges the feed and the mast cooks. The row burns with it.

bonus.text: One bead, and the spare solder is gone. The teeth will hold for one night and never again.

choices.label: Say the true mile out loud

success.text: She says the true mile once. The brush drips on the gravel, not the wood. The posts still wear the lie, wet.

failure.text: She says the lie again, and the moment to say the true mile is gone. The housing will not turn.

complication.text: She says the true mile as the lamp goes into the post, and the row burns.

bonus.text: She says the true mile once, steady. The brush never touches the post. The posts still wear the lie, wet.

chapters.title: The Switch House
chapters.setting: Nim's road-oil is in the housing and the teeth can catch. She memorized nothing, and the lamp is out. She will walk at dawn without a light. The paint is still wet on the false mile. Cranking the true tower calls Pell's listener and brings the scrap gang to the houses. A bearing read off the dark hills, with his hand stopped, leaves the listener behind and the posts false. A false number with the crank held still hides the houses and puts Nim on the lie in the dark.
chapters.objective: The oil is gone. Choose the hour, the bearing, or the lie.

choices.label: Crank the true tower and call the listener

success.text: The true tower goes out. The listener will come, and so will the gang. Nim runs the true mile in the dark.

failure.text: A blurred number goes out. The listener and the gang both hunt a mile that is neither the town nor a road.

complication.text: The crank shatters and the wet post burns. The wire dies with the row.

bonus.text: The true tower goes out on the first turn. The listener will come, and so will the gang. Nim runs the true mile in the dark.

choices.label: Read the tower off the dark hills and stop his hand

success.text: She reads the tower off the dark hills and stops his hand. The listener never comes. The posts stay false. She walks the bearing without a lamp.

failure.text: She loses the hills and does not stop his hand. A blurred number leaves the wire.

complication.text: Her knee goes on the fence, the crank turns wild, and the row burns.

bonus.text: She reads the tower off the dark hills clean and stops his hand. The listener never comes. The posts stay false. She walks the bearing without a lamp.

choices.label: Set the false number and keep the crank still

success.text: She sets the false number and keeps the crank still. The hour does not go out. Nim walks the lie with no lamp.

failure.text: The false number smears as his hand moves. A blurred mile leaves the wire.

complication.text: The brush knocks the housing and the wet post burns.

bonus.text: She sets the false number in one stroke and keeps the crank still. The hour does not go out. Nim walks the lie with no lamp.

chapters.title: The Salt Flat
chapters.setting: The true mile has been spoken once, and it is not on the wood. The posts still wear the lie, wet. Putting that mile on the wire calls the listener and the scrap gang to the houses. Walking it and leaving the posts lying keeps the wire silent. Painting the lie back over the words just said puts Nim on the false mile, and nothing goes out. The listener stops waiting at sunrise. At dawn the gang pulls every number that is still readable.
chapters.objective: The true mile has been said once. Put it on the wire, on her feet, or back in the lie.

choices.label: Put the mile she spoke on the wire

success.text: The mile she spoke goes out true. The listener will come. The gang will follow that hour to the houses.

failure.text: The spoken mile leaves the wire blurred. The listener and the gang both miss the town.

complication.text: The contact welds and the mast cooks. The row burns.

bonus.text: The mile she spoke goes out true on the first turn. The listener will come. The gang will follow that hour to the houses.

choices.label: Walk the mile she said and leave the posts lying

success.text: She walks the mile Maro said and leaves the posts lying. The wire stays silent. The listener never comes. The posts stay false.

failure.text: She loses the spoken mile on the flat, and a blurred number leaves the wire.

complication.text: The flat turns her into the mast and the row burns behind her.

bonus.text: She walks the mile Maro said without a miss and leaves the posts lying. The wire stays silent. The listener never comes. The posts stay false.

choices.label: Paint the lie back over the mile you just said

success.text: She paints the lie back over the mile she said. Nim walks the lie. Nothing goes out.

failure.text: The lie and the true mile mix on the wood, and a blurred number leaves the wire.

complication.text: The brush takes the lamp with it and the row burns.

bonus.text: She paints the lie back in one clean coat. Nim walks the lie. Nothing goes out.

chapters.title: The Relay
chapters.setting: The spare solder is already in the teeth. They will hold for one send, and the housing dies at dawn either way. The plate on the mast still carries the true tower. If the send goes out true, the listener comes and the scrap gang follows the hour to the houses. If the crank never turns, the listener never comes and the one send is refused.
chapters.objective: The teeth will hold for one send and never again. Spend that send, or refuse it.

choices.label: Spend the only send on the true tower

success.text: The only send carries the true tower. The listener will come, and the gang will follow the hour to the houses. The housing dies at dawn either way.

failure.text: The only send leaves as a blur. The listener and the gang both hunt the wrong salt.

complication.text: The teeth hold and then the feed burns. The row goes with it.

bonus.text: The only send carries the true tower on the first turn. The listener will come, and the gang will follow the hour to the houses. The housing dies at dawn either way.

choices.label: Pocket the true plate and keep his hand off the crank

success.text: She pockets the true plate and keeps his hand off the crank. The listener never comes. The posts never get the true number. The send he bought is refused.

failure.text: The plate slips and a blurred number leaves on the send.

complication.text: The plate shorts the housing and the row burns.

bonus.text: She pockets the true plate clean and keeps his hand off the crank. The listener never comes. The posts never get the true number. The send he bought is refused.

choices.label: Paint the plate false and do not let him crank

success.text: She paints the plate false and does not let him crank. The send is buried. The town stays hidden. Nim has no plate.

failure.text: The false coat smears and a blurred number still leaves the wire.

complication.text: The paint thins into the feed and the row burns.

bonus.text: She paints the plate false in one coat and does not let him crank. The send is buried. The town stays hidden. Nim has no plate.

chapters.title: The Relay, Uncranked
chapters.setting: The housing will not turn. Nothing you tried in the yard became a map, an hour, or a finished lie. The posts are still in the ground, and dawn will pull every number that is still readable.
chapters.objective: The housing will not turn. Choose which loss you will make true before dawn.

choices.label: Count the posts that still agree, scrape them, and walk

success.text: She counts a true pair, scrapes it, and walks. The lane is not marked. The hour cannot go out.

failure.text: The pair agrees and is wrong, and she is already walking it. Nothing goes out.

complication.text: The count knocks the lamp and the row burns.

bonus.text: She counts a true pair clean, scrapes it, and walks. The lane is not marked. The hour cannot go out.

choices.label: Finish the false mile and let it dry

success.text: She finishes the false mile and lets it dry. Nim gets no true mile. Nothing can go out. The gang will follow the painted mile away from the houses.

failure.text: The false mile will not dry clean. Nothing goes out. The numbers stay readable and wrong.

complication.text: The brush takes the lamp into the post and the row burns.

bonus.text: She finishes the false mile in one stroke and lets it dry. Nim gets no true mile. Nothing can go out. The gang will follow the painted mile away from the houses.

choices.label: Cut the feed so the hour cannot be saved

success.text: He cuts the feed. The hour cannot be saved. The false mile is what dries.

failure.text: The cut jumps. He staggers onto a mile he did not check. Nothing goes out.

complication.text: The knife shorts the mast and the posts cook. The row burns.

bonus.text: He cuts the feed clean. The hour cannot be saved. The false mile is what dries.

endings.title: The Hour Goes Out
endings.text: The wire carries the true tower. The listener is coming. The gang will follow that hour to the houses. Nim has the true mile and runs ahead of them. Maro's false number is gone. The town is found because the hour was true.

endings.title: The Mile in Her Head
endings.text: The wire stays silent. Nim walks a true bearing that was never put on the wire. The listener does not come. The posts dry without a true number, so the gang pulls markers and not the houses. Pell's hour dies unsent. The map leaves with Nim.

endings.title: Close Enough
endings.text: The posts dry on the false mile. No true number goes out. The listener never comes. The gang follows the painted mile away from the houses. Nim walks the lie at dawn. The town is still here because the numbers were wrong.

endings.title: A Mile Off
endings.text: A blurred number leaves the wire. The listener and the gang both hunt salt that is neither the town nor a road. Nim walks the blur and finds neither. The posts dry on a figure no one can swear to.

endings.title: Already Walking
endings.text: Nothing goes out. Nim is on a mile the posts do not agree on. The listener never comes. The numbers stay readable and wrong, so the gang searches the lane at dawn.

endings.title: The Row Burns
endings.text: The wire burns and the posts go blank before dawn. The listener hears static and turns back. The gang finds no number and searches the lane tonight. Nim has nothing to walk.
